name: duopore-public-scope-change-register
description: See how approved project changes affect your starting budget and schedule.
keywords: see how project changes add up

interface.shortDescription: See how project changes add up
interface.longDescription: See how approved project changes affect your starting budget and schedule. Share the original budget and length, then list proposed, approved and rejected changes. Only approved changes alter the totals. Keep the other requests visible for review. This is a planning record; it does not approve requests, change a contract or predict profit.
capabilities: See how project changes add up
defaultPrompt: Show how these approved scope changes affect my project.
Keep proposed changes separate from approved budget changes.

positive.prompt: Use Scope Change Register with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs.
